about: Someone leaves the company, or stops following it: by bond and manner. A person's own words (Leaves "..." in Kyr) are said instead.

lines.text: {Actor} holds on to you a moment longer than you expect. 'Come home when you can,' {actor} says, and turns back.
'Don't be long,' says {actor}. 'And don't do anything I wouldn't.'
'You know where to find me,' says {actor}.
{Actor} nods, settles {their} pack, and goes {their} own way without looking back.
'Here's where I leave you,' says {actor}. 'Mind the road.'
{Actor} lifts a hand, and is gone round the bend of the road.
{Actor} nods, and lets you go about your business.
